{{Quote|<nowiki/>''Chinnith'' to ''Anakin Solo''. You'll never guess who I just shot.|The Chev pilot contacts the ''Anakin Solo'' after the incident|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''Chev''' served as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]]. During the [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Centerpoint Station]], she shot [[Sadras Koyan]] [[Death/Legends|dead]] when he boarded the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Chinnith]]'' she was on.
